plan.coverage_explanation: Tests the specifically required startup text through the LCD text-output API. The available checks cannot verify landscape orientation, black background, white foreground, cursor position, text size, or declaration of a particular object type. These essential graphical and structural requirements remain unverified.
assumptions: The supplied circuit is authoritative: D/C=9, CS=10, MOSI=11, MISO=12, SCK=13, and RST=8.
Landscape rotation 1 is a permitted landscape orientation.
The LCD API text capture exposes text printed through Adafruit_ILI9341.
